senses.gloss: f. pl. (v. סְגֵי I, cmp. מוּרְבִּית) [made of twigs, leaves,] loosely woven mats used for covering up fruit.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:5">Kel. XVI, 5</cite> <he>ס׳ של עלין</he> (R. S. <he>סוּגְ׳</he>) mats made of leaves; <he>ס׳ של נצר</he> of wicker.—[<he>סיגניות</he>, <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 232:3">Yalk. Ex. 232</cite>, v. <cite ref="O00567"><he>סִיגְנוֹן</he></cite>.]
